verdict.rationale: Companies House's own REST API exposes register records, including a user's own company data, through simple GET requests on unique resource URIs. The site also lets users view company data and document images. That is a machine-readable route to get data out, but nothing describes a full self-service export of everything a user has filed, and open formats are never explicitly documented. missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export of all of the user's data, an explicit statement of open export formats, an account-closure or leaving path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
